identity: The policy applies the following condition provision under BPF 04 47 edition 04 24 to Location 001, Building 001, Hired and Non-Owned Auto. The insured must keep records supporting the Liability Limit valuation basis, 80% coinsurance entry, and Actual Loss Sustained business income basis for Location 001, Building 001, Hired and Non-Owned Auto.

record.clause_text: For Location 001, Building 001, Hired and Non-Owned Auto, read BPF 04 47 edition 04 24 as the controlling condition provision. The scheduled limit of $275,000 and deductible of $10,000 apply to Location 001, Building 001, Hired and Non-Owned Auto under form BPF 04 47 edition 04 24.
